import { Tabs, TabItem } from "@astrojs/starlight/components";
import ComponentStates from "../../../../../components/ui/ComponentStates.astro";

Renders its children only while an entitlement holds; otherwise a slot of the host's choosing or the paywall. It renders nothing of its own while the entitlement is loading.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** `EntitlementGate(screen:content:locked:)` around a feature.

    **Styled part.** The `locked` slot.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.entitlementGate(_:)`: only the entitlement decides; a theme or style never unlocks.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
